tasks.name: Inicializar monorepo pnpm + Turborepo
tasks.postcondition: Estructura monorepo con pnpm-workspace.yaml, turbo.json, package.json raíz
tasks.invariant: pnpm install debe completar sin errores
tasks.gherkin:
Feature: Monorepo scaffolding
Scenario: Initialize monorepo
Given an empty project directory
When I run pnpm install
Then all workspace packages resolve without error

tasks.name: Scaffolding apps/api (NestJS)
tasks.postcondition: NestJS app funcionando con estructura de módulos: identity, catalog, contacts, opportunities, activities, agenda, automations, campaigns, reporting, documents, notifications, audit. Cada uno con domain/application/infrastructure/interface
tasks.invariant: nest start debe arrancar sin error. Swagger UI en /api/docs
tasks.gherkin:
Feature: NestJS scaffolding
Scenario: API starts
Given the NestJS app is initialized
When I run nest start
Then the server starts on port 3000
And Swagger UI is available at /api/docs

tasks.name: Scaffolding apps/web (Next.js)
tasks.gherkin:
Feature: Next.js scaffolding
Scenario: Web starts
Given the Next.js app is initialized
When I run next dev
Then the dev server starts without error

tasks.name: Configurar Prisma + PostgreSQL
tasks.postcondition: Prisma schema con modelos base (User, Role, Permission, AuditLog). Migrations aplicadas a PostgreSQL
tasks.invariant: prisma generate y prisma migrate dev completan sin error
tasks.gherkin:
Feature: Database setup
Scenario: Prisma connects to PostgreSQL
Given Prisma is configured
When I run prisma migrate dev
Then the database schema is created
And User, Role, Permission, AuditLog tables exist

tasks.name: Configurar Railway Nixpacks
tasks.postcondition: railway.json configurado. Nixpacks detecta servicios. Variables de entorno documentadas
tasks.gherkin:
Feature: Railway deployment
Scenario: Nixpacks build
Given Railway Nixpacks is configured
When I run nixpacks build
Then the build succeeds without a Dockerfile

tasks.name: Configurar tests (Jest + Vitest)
tasks.postcondition: Jest configurado en apps/api, Vitest en apps/web. Scripts pnpm test funcionan
tasks.invariant: pnpm test ejecuta tests sin error
tasks.gherkin:
Feature: Test configuration
Scenario: Run tests
Given Jest and Vitest are configured
When I run pnpm test
Then all test suites pass

tasks.name: Configurar CI básico
tasks.postcondition: Pipeline CI con lint, typecheck, tests funcionando
tasks.invariant: CI pipeline se ejecuta sin error
tasks.gherkin:
Feature: CI pipeline
Scenario: CI runs
Given CI pipeline is configured
When code is pushed
Then lint, typecheck, and tests run automatically

tasks.name: Configurar packages compartidos
tasks.postcondition: packages/contracts con tipos base. packages/config con configuraciones
tasks.invariant: pnpm build en packages completa sin error
tasks.gherkin:
Feature: Shared packages
Scenario: Build shared packages
Given packages/contracts and packages/config exist
When I run pnpm build
Then both packages build successfully
